title: Can't use scene data for compositor effect in mobile renderer
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in 4.6.2-stable
- Works correctly in 4.5-stable

### System information

Windows 11 - Mobile Vulkan

### Issue description

A [recent change](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111183) in the renderer where we introduced using dynamic buffers in the mobile renderer, broke the ability to use scene data in compositor effects. 

The log is spammed with:
```
  ERROR: servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:4073 - Condition "!driver_uniform_set" is true. Returning: RID()
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/uniform_set_cache_rd.h:120 - Condition "rid.is_null()" is true. Returning: rid
  ERROR: servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:4786 - Parameter "uniform_set" is null.
  ERROR: Uniforms were never supplied for set (0) at the time of drawing, which are required by the pipeline.
  ERROR: Sent a buffer with BUFFER_USAGE_DYNAMIC_PERSISTENT_BIT but binding (0), set (0) is UNIFORM_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER instead of UNIFORM_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC.
```
The type issue is easily resolved, however an incorrect RID being returned by [RenderSceneData.get_uniform_buffer](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_renderscenedata.html#class-renderscenedata-method-get-uniform-buffer) isn't.

This is a regression in 4.6, but seeing the below it should not be considered a showstopper for 4.7. Fine enough for this to be fixed in 4.7.1 and cherry picked for 4.6.4.

> [!NOTE]
> Compositor effect on the mobile renderer are rarely used atm because you can't use compute shaders with the render target textures and there wasn't a good example for using raster shaders. But there is demand for this feature.
>
> I recently implemented a raster shader version of this and expect people to start adopting this, however they will run into this limitation. 

### Steps to reproduce

Create a compositor effect that uses `RenderSceneData.get_uniform_buffer`.

See the MRP, it's too much setup to explain here but the MRP shows the issue well.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://codeberg.org/BastiaanOlij/mobile-compositor-effect
